about.mardoodIsAPilotProjectBuilt: Mardood is a pilot project built during a hackathon to make it easier to find and use offers from local stores in Salamieh.
about.aStoreSOfferCanReach: A store’s offer can reach more people when it has a clear, shareable link. Mardood brings the offer details, price, and discount pass together. Customers show the pass when paying cash in store.
about.howDoWeConnectStoresCustomers: How Do We Connect Stores, Customers, and Marketers?
about.theMerchantCreatesAnOfferAnd: The merchant creates an offer and confirms the pass at checkout. The marketer shares the offer link and may earn a commission when an eligible sale is attributed to their referral. The customer can review the offer, get a discount pass, and track cashback on eligible purchases from their account.
about.weWantShoppersToFindOffers: We want shoppers to find offers in Salamieh more easily and see the details before visiting. We also want stores to be able to share and confirm offers clearly.

privacy.thisDraftDescribesTheDataThe: This draft describes the data the Mardood pilot uses for sign-in, displaying discounts, confirming purchases, and tracking cashback.
privacy.draftForTheProjectOwnerTo: Draft for the project owner to review before publication.
privacy.youSignInWithAPhone: You sign in with a phone number and password. The site uses your name, phone number, and account role, such as customer, merchant, or marketer. Your role determines which pages and actions are available. Merchant profiles also include store information and verification status.
privacy.whenYouOpenAnOfferLink: When you open an offer link, the site sends its referral code to the server to record the visit. An issued discount pass is linked to the offer, the customer account, and the originating referral so the pass can be checked at checkout and the sale can be attributed.
privacy.aCustomerSAccountShowsConfirmed: A customer’s account shows confirmed purchases, including the store and product names, amount paid, cashback earned, and confirmation date. The site shows available and locked balances and progress toward unlocking them. Eligible referral sales are used to calculate marketer commissions.

privacy.beforePublicationIdentifyWhoIsResponsibl: Before publication, identify who is responsible for the data and how to contact them, define retention periods and the process for access, correction, or deletion requests, and document any third parties that may process the data and why.

terms.thisDraftExplainsHowOffersDiscount: This draft explains how offers, discount passes, and cashback work in the Mardood pilot.
terms.purposeOfThePlatformAndYour: Purpose of the Platform and Your Account
terms.mardoodHelpsYouFindOffersFrom: Mardood helps you find offers from participating stores and track eligible purchases. Pay cash in store. Use your own account and keep your password and session details private.
terms.checkTheProductPriceAndExpiration: Check the product, price, and expiration date before visiting a store. An offer can end when it expires, stock runs out, or the campaign is closed. The site checks availability when you get a pass and when the merchant confirms a purchase.
terms.showTheQrCodeOrManual: Show the QR code or manual code at checkout. The verified merchant responsible for the offer checks the cash amount due and confirms payment to record the sale. Each discount pass can be used once.
terms.cashbackIsRecordedAfterAnEligible: Cashback is recorded after an eligible purchase is confirmed. Your cycle balance unlocks once you meet both the required confirmed purchase count and the minimum spend. The cashback page shows the requirements and your progress.
terms.useAPassForAGenuine: Use a pass for a genuine purchase covered by its offer. Avoid recording purchases that did not happen or confirming a pass that has already been used. The pilot is limited to features available through the current Mardood interfaces.
terms.beforePublicationApproveTheOperatorS: Before publication, approve the operator’s details, the support channel, and how to handle complaints and disputes about recorded purchases.
